correctness.rationale: Exact analytic reduction to F(c), positive-denominator quadratic derivative Q(c²), discriminant 4s(s-4a)(s²-1)², and Q(1)=s(as³-2s²+4) prove all modes and endpoints. The vertex lies above c²=1 for s>4a, so z+>1; the cubic has exactly two crossings for 1/2<a<4/(3sqrt6). Exact rational and independent direct numerical checks from verify.py corroborate, but the proof is not based on finite sampling.
